title: Version 3.1.0 Changelog
items: Switch file encryption to AES-GCM-HKDF streaming with 1 MB segments
Serve single-file downloads with HTTP Range 206 responses
Add envelope encryption so key rotation only rewraps stored keys
Ship resumable scripts for key rotation and the one-time backfill
Stop rejecting uploads on a MIME type mismatch
Detect the stored MIME type from file content on the S3 path
Redesign the public file and folder share pages
Let shared folder rows browse into subfolders
Zip the current level with 'Download all' on share pages
Return a generic 404 for folders outside a share
Show real per-file progress for downloads and open-on-desktop
Stream real progress for delete, restore and permanent delete
Split large select-all deletes into batches of 500
Render toolbar tooltips in a portal so the header can't clip them
Fix an unhandled promise rejection in the streaming-migrate script
Split the backend into thin barrels with per-concern modules
Split the frontend into thin shells with per-concern hooks
Split the electron and desktop-fs code into barrels and partial classes
Add an ESLint max-lines guardrail on the backend
Bump CI action tag versions
Update backend, frontend and electron dependencies
